GetJobResultResp.description_en: The results of a migration job, including retry information for failed files and migration statistics

AddressType.description_en: The data address type for the retry job. This value indicates that the data address is constructed from a failed file inventory. Use this value as the AddressType parameter when you create a data address for a retry job
AddressType.description_zh: 根据失败文件列表构造的地址类型。构造新的数据地址时，填入AddressType字段
AddressType.title: 根据失败文件列表构造的地址类型。构造新的数据地址时，填入AddressType字段。

CopiedObjectCount.description_en: The number of objects that were processed successfully. This value includes both migrated objects and skipped objects
CopiedObjectCount.description_zh: 迁移成功的文件数量，包括成功和跳过的文件
CopiedObjectCount.title: 迁移成功的文件数量。包括成功和跳过的文件。

CopiedObjectSize.description_en: The total size of objects that were processed successfully. Unit: bytes
CopiedObjectSize.description_zh: 迁移成功的文件数据量
CopiedObjectSize.title: 迁移成功的文件数据量。

FailedObjectCount.description_en: The number of objects that failed to migrate
FailedObjectCount.title: 迁移失败的文件数量。

InvAccessId.description_en: The AccessKey ID that is used to access the bucket where the failed file list is stored. Use this value as the InvAccessId parameter when you create a data address for a retry job
InvAccessId.description_zh: 失败文件列表存储空间的AccessKeyId。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvAccessId字段
InvAccessId.title: 失败文件列表存储空间的AccessKeyId。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvAccessId字段。

InvAccessSecret.description_en: The AccessKey secret that is used to access the bucket where the failed file list is stored. Use this value as the InvAccessSecret parameter when you create a data address for a retry job
InvAccessSecret.description_zh: 失败文件列表存储空间的SecretAccessKey。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvAccessSecret字段
InvAccessSecret.title: 失败文件列表存储空间的SecretAccessKey。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvAccessSecret字段。

InvBucket.description_en: The name of the bucket that stores the failed file list. Use this value as the InvBucket parameter when you create a data address for a retry job
InvBucket.description_zh: 失败文件列表存储空间。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvBucket字段
InvBucket.title: 失败文件列表存储空间。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvBucket字段。

InvDomain.description_en: The endpoint of the bucket that stores the failed file list. Use this value as the InvDomain parameter when you create a data address for a retry job
InvDomain.description_zh: 失败文件列表存储空间域名。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvDomain字段
InvDomain.title: 失败文件列表存储空间域名。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvDomain字段。

InvLocation.description_en: The storage type of the bucket that stores the failed file list, such as oss. Use this value as the InvLocation parameter when you create a data address for a retry job
InvLocation.description_zh: 失败文件列表存储空间类型。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvLocation字段
InvLocation.title: 失败文件列表存储空间类型。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvLocation字段。

InvPath.description_en: The path to the manifest file that lists the failed files. Use this value as the InvPath parameter when you create a data address for a retry job
InvPath.description_zh: 失败文件列表清单文件。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvPath字段
InvPath.title: 失败文件列表清单文件。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvPath字段。

InvRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the bucket that stores the failed file list. Use this value as the InvRegionId parameter when you create a data address for a retry job
InvRegionId.description_zh: 失败文件存储空间区域。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvRegionId字段
InvRegionId.title: 失败文件存储空间区域。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvRegionId字段。

ReadyRetry.description_en: The retry readiness status for failed files. Valid values: NoNeed indicates that all files were migrated successfully and no retry is required. Ready indicates that the failed file list has been generated and is available for retry. NotReady indicates that the failed file list is being generated.
ReadyRetry.description_zh:
失败文件是否可重试。  
取值：NoNeed，无需重试；Ready，失败文件列表准备完成；NotReady，失败文件列表准备中
ReadyRetry.title: 失败文件是否可重试。取值：NoNeed，无需重试；Ready，失败文件列表准备完成；NotReady，失败文件列表准备中。

SkippedObjectCount.description_en: The number of objects that were skipped during migration. Objects are skipped when they already exist at the destination and meet the configured skip conditions
SkippedObjectCount.title: 跳过的文件数量。

SkippedObjectSize.description_en: The total size of objects that were skipped during migration. Unit: bytes
SkippedObjectSize.title: 跳过的文件size。

TotalObjectCount.description_en: The total number of objects in the source data address
TotalObjectCount.title: 总文件数量。

TotalObjectSize.description_en: The total size of all objects in the source data address. Unit: bytes
TotalObjectSize.title: 文件总数据量。

Version.description_en: The unique identifier of the migration job
Version.title: 任务ID。

GetJobResultResp.title: 任务重试信息详情。

description_en: Obtains the list of files that fail to be migrated when files fail to be migrated during a migration task
description_zh: 当迁移任务有失败文件时，获取失败文件是否能重试的信息
name: GetJobResult

parameters.help_en: The execution ID of the task
parameters.name: runtime_id

schema.description_zh: 获取任务重试信息响应体

ImportJobResult.description_zh: 获取任务重试信息详情
